descriptions.value: Invocation of the Jolokia special agent with the login password in the command line in Checkmk versions 2.5.0 before 2.5.0p16 allows a local user on the Checkmk server to read the Jolokia login password from the process list while the special agent is running. This affects both explicitly configured passwords and passwords from the password store.

descriptions.description: CWE-214: Invocation of Process Using Visible Sensitive Information

assertions.title: Jolokia special agent exposes password in process list

title: Jolokia special agent exposes password in process list

descriptions.value: Out of bounds write in GPU in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.50 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

In multiple locations, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds read and temporary denial of service due to improper input validation. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
